scope: Neutral character rules, values, resource identities and starting equipment; no scripts or art assets.

interpretation.startingWeapons: Selectable starting weapon alternatives, not a grant of every listed weapon.
interpretation.startingItems: Selectable starting item alternatives, not a grant of every listed item.
interpretation.guaranteedEquipment: Fixed grants from starting_item, cursed_starting_item or starting_weapon effects.
interpretation.limits: Serialized resource facts only. Script defaults, runtime algorithms, scenes and visual fields are not reproduced.

versionEvidence.method: Highest semantic-version ASCII literal plus Steam build/update metadata; no decompilation
